sources.title: Muoniolalusta/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-UNCENSORED-affinity-2.875bpw ...
sources.snippet: A quantised affinity container of the uncensored DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, made to run on two AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201) GPUs. It loads only in the affinity engine (the C++/HIP inference engine by Yoshi Exeler) with the V4.1 port — not in llama.cpp, vLLM or SGLang. Full setup, engine patches ...
